articles.excerpt: The FBI and EPA Warning on Water-Sector PLCs: What the MicroLogix Campaign Exposed On 30 July 2026, the FBI and the Environmental Protection Agency issued joint product security advisory I-073026-PSA…
articles.body: The FBI and EPA Warning on Water-Sector PLCs: What the MicroLogix Campaign Exposed On 30 July 2026, the FBI and the Environmental Protection Agency issued joint product security advisory I-073026-PSA covering a campaign against water and wastewater systems. Incidents were reported from 27 July onward, across at least seven states, with some reporting counting more. The advisory named the target class directly: Rockwell Automation and Allen-Bradley MicroLogix 1100 and 1400 series programmable logic controllers. What the controllers do, and where they were sitting MicroLogix 1100 and 1400 units are compact controllers used for pump control, valve scheduling and the local logic that keeps a distribution network in balance.

articles.title: Tenant Incidents: Node.js Feature Flags, Caching, Fallback Defaults, and Audit Trails
articles.excerpt: The hard trade-off in a property-management experiment is freshness versus reconstructability: polling faster can shorten exposure to an unwanted flag state, but no polling interval can explain a past…
articles.body: The hard trade-off in a property-management experiment is freshness versus reconstructability: polling faster can shorten exposure to an unwanted flag state, but no polling interval can explain a past decision unless the application records which configuration generation, fallback path, and tenant cohort produced it. TL;DR: keep the last verified snapshot in process, define a conservative default for every flag, refresh with jitter, and emit a compact decision record beside the business event. Treat the remote flag service as a control plane, never as a synchronous dependency of a rent, maintenance, or tenant-notification request. Evidence first. Suppose a team is comparing a new maintenance-triage flow across tenant cohorts.

articles.title: How to Write a 1980s Photo Prompt That Looks Like a Real 1985 Snapshot
articles.excerpt: A good 1980s photo prompt doesn't just say "make it look retro." It tells the image model which camera took the picture, how the light hit the subject, and what was on the film. Leave those details ou…
articles.body: A good 1980s photo prompt doesn't just say "make it look retro." It tells the image model which camera took the picture, how the light hit the subject, and what was on the film. Leave those details out and you usually get a modern, over-sharp image with a beige filter on top. This guide breaks down what makes an AI image read as a genuine 1980s photograph, gives you a prompt you can paste straight into ChatGPT or Gemini to turn your own selfie into a 1985 photo, and points to a free gallery of retro AI prompts you can copy and adapt. Why most "retro" AI prompts miss the 1980s look Most prompts fail because they describe a style instead of a capture. "80s style portrait" leaves the model to guess, and it often guesses wrong: clean skin, perfect focus, a phone-camera dynamic range.

articles.body: 디지털 자산 시장은 주류 금융 시스템으로의 통합을 향해 거침없이 나아가고 있지만, 그 과정은 결코 순탄하지 않다. 최근의 전개 상황은 흥미로우면서도 종종 모순적인 역동성을 보여준다. 한편으로는 전통 금융 기관(TradFi)들이 암호화폐 기반 기업들이 이룩한 규제적 진전을 적극적으로 견제하고 있다. 다른 한편으로는 금융계의 가장 유서 깊은 이름들이 바로 그 혁신 기업들과 전략적 제휴를 맺고 있는 모습이다. 이러한 경쟁과 실용적 협력이 동시에 나타나는 두 갈래 길은 광범위한 금융 생태계 내에서 암호화폐 및 블록체인 부문의 현재 진화를 정의한다. 유력 은행 그룹이 미국 규제 당국이 암호화폐 기업에 신탁 인가를 내준 것에 대해 법적 조치를 시작했다는 소식은 뿌리 깊은 경쟁적 긴장과 규제 명확성 및 시장 점유율을 둘러싼 지속적인 싸움을 여실히 보여준다. 이 법적 분쟁은 단순히 특정 인가에 대한 문제가 아니다. 이는 기존 금융 기관과 민첩하고 디지털 기반의 경쟁자들 사이의 적절한 규제 범위와 '공정한 경쟁의 장'에 대한 근본적인 논쟁을 대변한다. 동시에 글로벌 보관 서비스의 거인인 BNY Mellon과 암호화폐 거래소 Kraken의 모회사인 Payward 간의 논의는 전략적 통합으로의 중대한 전환을 시사한다. 이러한 파트너십은 전통 금융이 한편으로는 암호화폐와 싸우면서도, 진화하는 고객 요구를 충족하고 미래의 관련성을 확보하는 데 필수적인 블록체인 기반 기업들이 제공하는 인프라와 전문성을 인식하고 있다는 점을 나타낸다.

articles.body: As autonomous AI agents shift from experimental scripts into production systems, the way software engineering teams extend agent capabilities has fundamentally changed. Frameworks like CrewAI, AutoGen, LangChain, and custom internal agent platforms rely on modular packages generally referred to as Skill Bundles. An AI skill bundle is a simple, highly functional unit: an installable package containing natural language instructions (typically inside a SKILL.md file) paired with supporting execution scripts written in Python, Shell, JavaScript, or PowerShell.

articles.title: Credit Clinic explores the consequences of one film credit
articles.excerpt: This is a submission for the Sanity Challenge, Path Two: Vibe-Code Something Strange. Credit Clinic is a reference-impact lab for people learning how connected content behaves. Choose a film, follow a…
articles.body: This is a submission for the Sanity Challenge, Path Two: Vibe-Code Something Strange . What I Built Credit Clinic is a reference-impact lab for people learning how connected content behaves. Choose a film, follow a cast or crew credit to its person document, and rehearse a change in a browser-local copy. The result shows which films depend on that person and how different changes produce different consequences. The source snapshot contains 14 films, 186 person documents, and 210 credit references, with zero unresolved credit references. A three-part workbench makes those relationships inspectable: select a film, trace a credit, then test its impact. Each credit exposes its film ID, array field and key, target person ID, and reference strength.
